case_title: CALIFORNIA APPAREL NEWS VS KANTSOVA IRENKA

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,545.00 FILED BY CALIFORNIA APPAREL NEWS AS TO DEFENDANT KANTSOVA IRENKA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-31-1991 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 06

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CALIFORNIA APPAREL NEWS RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT KANTSOVA IRENKA $1,300.00 PRINCIPAL, $8.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,308.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
